signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: CRO: Define, defend and run the conversion funnel testing roadmap, shipping 6–10 experiments with clear rationale and clean readouts in the first 90 days.
New product launches: Own end-to-end product lifecycle from problem definition through experiment, analysis and launch, requirements, and instrumentation, with at least one launch…
Growth data and analytics: Do your own analysis balancing tradeoffs between product metrics and revenue impact, and partner with RevOps on deeper insights and dashboards.
Reporting: Write a weekly exec readout,keep a findings library and conduct live insight reviews with the broader organization to share learnings.
KPIs: CVR (direct & rep-assisted), revenue, on-time launches with instrumented funnels
